statusText: Tail remains in the low band; stress is elevated by tech weakness, rates and geopolitical headlines, while live one-way NQ structure is not sufficiently verified.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Current evidence does not establish persistent mean-reversion failure.
headline: Low Tail risk with elevated event and technology stress
body: Monday's Nasdaq decline was led by technology and semiconductor weakness while Treasury yields eased modestly and oil fell. The setup raises stress, but available evidence does not verify a persistent overnight NQ no-retracement path. The main conditional risk window is the U.S. data and cash-open sequence.

lookbackSummary: No qualifying previously published ChatGPT assessment was resolved for the exact preceding 24 UTC clock-hour slots, so all lookback slots are marked unavailable rather than reconstructed with hindsight.
outlookSummary: Tail is expected to remain low overnight, rise into watch only around the U.S. data/cash-open sequence, then recede if price discovery becomes two-way. Stress remains higher than Tail because rates, Iran headlines, technology weakness and the week's major scheduled catalysts can produce volatility without necessarily creating a persistent no-retracement path.

forecast.analysis: Current evidence is mixed: Monday's tech-led Nasdaq decline and semiconductor weakness raise stress, but fresh live NQ retracement structure is not sufficiently verified to justify elevated Tail.
drivers: Live NQ path evidence is incomplete

news.title: S&P 500, Nasdaq end down on tech stocks, investors weigh Iran moves

forecast.analysis: Early European overnight conditions are expected to remain headline-sensitive; without fresh one-way NQ extension, Tail stays low while uncertainty around rates, Iran and AI positioning persists.
Thin overnight liquidity can magnify moves, but this hour remains conditionally low-Tail unless NQ begins holding an extreme with shallow or failed retracements.
Asia-to-Europe transition risk remains moderate. A sustained directional handoff across equities, yields and semiconductors would be needed to lift Tail above the low band.
European morning liquidity should improve evidence quality. Orderly two-way trade would keep Tail low; repeated extensions without meaningful retracement would challenge that view.
Rate sensitivity remains a background stressor after elevated long yields. Tail remains conditional on whether futures convert that backdrop into persistent directional efficiency.
European cash trading may clarify breadth and tech leadership. Conflicting cross-asset signals favor a mixed regime rather than a pre-emptive Tail block.
With U.S. catalysts still hours away, event anticipation can raise volatility without proving mean-reversion failure. Tail remains low absent aligned continuation.
Pre-U.S. positioning can become less liquid and more reactive to headlines. Watch for semiconductor and megacap alignment, but treat any future alignment as conditional.
Approaching U.S. premarket, Monday's tech weakness remains relevant context. A stable futures range or meaningful retracements would argue against a pathological path.

news.title: S&P 500, Nasdaq end down on tech stocks, investors weigh Iran moves

forecast.analysis: Into the data/open approach, stress rises because New Home Sales and confidence-related data can shift rates. Event importance alone does not establish Tail.
The 14:00 UTC U.S. data window is a whipsaw checkpoint. Tail enters watch only if the release response becomes one-way with shallow pullbacks and cross-asset confirmation.
U.S. cash-open price discovery is the main path-risk window. A directional opening auction that repeatedly extends after failed retracements would justify the higher watch score.
The first post-open hour carries the highest conditional Tail in this forecast. The watch state assumes possible opening continuation, not an observed future trend.
By the second cash-session hour, Tail can recede if retracements broaden and volatility normalizes; continued extreme-holding would keep the watch regime relevant.
Mid-session risk should ease if the opening impulse loses directional efficiency. Persistent semiconductor/megacap alignment with yields would delay normalization.
Early afternoon conditions favor lower stress absent a fresh catalyst. Tail returns toward the low threshold if price discovery is two-way rather than extension-driven.
Later afternoon risk is expected to normalize further, though headline sensitivity around Iran sanctions and the week's major catalysts remains a background driver.

news.title: S&P 500, Nasdaq end down on tech stocks, investors weigh Iran moves

forecast.analysis: Pre-power-hour structure is conditionally normal. A renewed directional break with failed retracements would be the principal reason for Tail to re-enter watch.
Power-hour liquidity can revive directional moves, but no automatic block is warranted. Tail stays low unless late-session continuation becomes unusually efficient.
Into the U.S. close, closing-flow concentration may raise short-lived volatility. Mean-reverting or two-way auction behavior would keep Tail low.
Post-close liquidity thins and company headlines can matter more. Nvidia earnings are still a future event, so only positioning uncertainty is reflected here.
Early after-hours conditions should be calmer if no new catalyst arrives. Tail remains low, with the next day's GDP/PCE and durable-goods cluster outside this 24-hour horizon.
